correctness.rationale: For a triple u<v<w, b^r+b^s=b^t forces r=s and b=2, and four 1 positions are excluded; hence support is at most 2 (b≥3) or at most 3 (b=2, with equal power-of-two adjacent gaps). Summing singleton, two-point and, in base two, triple placements yields both p_b(n) exact formulas including n=1 and power endpoints. In the Cantor–Bendixson derivative only singleton points and the zero point survive; any shift-equivariant homeomorphism translates the singleton orbit uniformly, and after normalization a finite-radius local rule fixes every sufficiently widely spaced multi-marker orbit. Isolated freely shifted multi-marker orbits are countably infinite, so automorphisms consist precisely of finitely supported orbit permutations plus integral phases. Conversely such finite modifications extend continuously at the only accumulation strata, proving the full restricted wreath product and its trivial factor center. Distinct leading n log n coefficients are invariant under finite-radius conjugacies. Independent support/word enumerations test small bases and lengths; the topological group proof, not enumeration, is unrestricted.
